title: Faux Snow Flurries at Arthurs Seat Eagle
summary: Magical faux snow moments on the hour, every hour throughout school holidays from 11am–4pm. Transforms the Arthurs Seat summit into a wintery playground. Best with a hot chocolate in hand.
priceRange: Gondola ticket required; check website for pricing
recurrenceNote: Snow on the hour 11am–4pm daily during school holidays (Jul 5–19)
suitableFor: Families with children, school holiday groups
accessibilityNotes: Gondola accessible; contact venue for mobility requirements
weatherDependency: Outdoor experience at summit - bring warm layers; some shelter at top station
nearbyAttractions: Arthurs Seat State Park; Seawinds Garden; Koonya Bushland Reserve
suggestedItineraryPairing: Gondola ride up, faux snow on the hour, hot chocolate at the summit cafe, walk the Arthurs Seat lookout trail before riding back down
editorVerdict: Best school holiday trick on the Peninsula this winter. Kids lose their minds for it.
editorNote:
Arthurs Seat Eagle is running faux snow every hour on the hour from 11am to 4pm throughout the July school holidays. Ride the gondola up, wait for the snow, stand in it, repeat as required. The summit cafe does hot chocolates and the views across the bay are genuinely spectacular even on a grey July day.

Ends July 19 when school goes back so don't sleep on it.

Book the gondola online - it sells out on good weather weekend days. Wrap the kids up; the summit is noticeably colder than sea level.
